title: Surge mitigator: reduce KV lease churn and simplify scheduler fast-path
creator: Marcus Chen
description: Problem: In high-concurrency / burst scenarios our KV lease churn creates hotspots and frequent lease renewals that increase tail latency and GC pressure. The legacy scheduler fast-path has multiple conditional handoffs that both add contention and make reasoning about liveness hard. This ticket aims to: 1) introduce a lightweight lease coalescer to batch renewals for short-lived sessions, 2) simplify the scheduler fast-path by removing a conditional handoff layer and replacing it with a single-hop surge-mitigation token, and 3) add targeted telemetry and alarms so we can measure change in tail P99/P999 latency and lease renewal rate.
acceptance_criteria: End-to-end e2e tests covering normal and burst modes (synthetic harness attached)
P99 generation latency during synthetic 5x burst reduces by >= 20% on staging
KV lease renewal RPS reduced by >= 35% under the same load profile
No increase in request error rate or dropped sessions on canary
Rollout plan documented and canary/circuit-breaker included
outcome_risks_and_tradeoffs: Coalescing lease renewals increases risk of stale leases during long-tail sessions; mitigated by conservative backstop timers and a fallback path that re-issues a synchronous lease if token unresolved after N ms. Removing the conditional handoff simplifies the fast-path but may make some rare admission fairness cases slightly less optimal; we will monitor fairness metrics and revert the change if fairness degradation exceeds threshold.
work_items: Implement coalescer in kvcache manager with feature flag
Remove conditional handoff from scheduler fast-path and wire surge token
Add unit + integration tests and synthetic harness scenarios
Canary rollout: 5% -> 25% -> 100% with automated rollback on error spike
comments: 2025-01-16 - MC: Kicked off design doc. Initial latency trace from last incident attached; root cause looks like lease renewals correlated with admission throttles.
2025-01-20 - AP: Implemented a first-pass coalescer proto. Local microbench shows coalescing 8 leases into 1 RPC reduces syscall rate by ~3.2x. Pushed branch ENG-459007/lease-coalescer (PR coming).
2025-01-24 - LP (Infra): Concern about coalescer adding jitter to eviction windows — suggested a deterministic jitter bound. Added to design doc in Confluence (see attachments).

2025-01-27 - AP: Removed conditional handoff from scheduler fast-path in branch ENG-459007/surge-token. Integration test flakeyness observed around admission counters; instrumented extra counters to verify invariants.

2025-01-30 - MC: Perf run on staging (k8s-staging cluster) with synthetic 3x burst: P99 down 18%, KV lease RPS down 29%. We are short of the 35% target; plan to tune coalescer window and surge-token threshold. Dashboard link attached.

2025-02-02 - AP: Opened PRs: GitHub #r/redwood/infra/pull/1287 (coalescer) and #r/redwood/runtime/pull/1299 (scheduler fast-path). Requesting review from @lucia and @ethan. Planning 5% canary next week.
